coverageSummary: 24 dashboard/spec.md scenarios: 0 missing, 0 contradicted. confirmedFindings.title: HttpAguiPublisher.publish() had no fetch timeout and RUN_STARTED was awaited before sendChatAction — a slow-but-up dashboard could stall every bot turn, breaking NFR-UX-01's typing-ack-first
confirmedFindings.fix: safePublish is now fire-and-forget (never awaited); HttpAguiPublisher fetch uses AbortSignal.timeout(2000); sendChatAction runs before the first publish. Tests: ack-before-publish order + a never-resolving publisher does not hang handleUpdate.

confirmedFindings.title: Conversation panel was seeded only by live events, never from the initial/reconnect STATE_SNAPSHOT — a lead mid-intake showed the 'no conversations' empty state on load/reconnect (contradicts empty-state + reconnect scenarios)
confirmedFindings.fix: seedConversationsFromActiveRequests wired into the dashboard STATE_SNAPSHOT branch + DashboardApp lazy initial state from initialSnapshot.activeRequests (seeds conversations AND requestCards so FIX 3's gate does not drop resumed-conversation deltas). Test: DashboardApp.test.tsx renders the active request's card with no live events.

confirmedFindings.title: STATE_DELTA for an unknown thread was not ignored (only BOOKING_PENDING was) — it created an orphan requestCards entry, violating the 'event referencing an unknown request id is ignored' scenario
confirmedFindings.fix: STATE_DELTA branch returns state unchanged when no requestCards[threadId] exists (the pipeline always emits STATE_SNAPSHOT first for a new thread, so a delta legitimately only patches an existing card). Tests added.

confirmedFindings.title: applyJsonPatch had no denylist for __proto__/constructor/prototype path segments — a prototype-pollution vector reachable via the arbitrary-JSON ingest route
confirmedFindings.fix: hasDangerousSegment guard folded into the existing discard branch (path and from), covering add/remove/replace/move/copy. Tests prove no Object/String.prototype pollution and other batch ops still apply.

confirmedFindings.title: POST /api/agui/ingest published any valid-JSON body with no shape validation (e.g. {} or {"type":123})
confirmedFindings.fix: isShapeLikeAguiEvent check (object + string type) -> 400 without publishing, mirroring the non-JSON 400 path.

confirmedFindings.title: DELETE /api/leads/[id] did not validate a numeric id — a non-numeric segment produced a misleading 404 instead of a 400
confirmedFindings.fix: Number.isInteger(leadId) && leadId > 0 guard before any DB query -> 400 with a deterministic Ukrainian message.

confirmedFindings.title: tasks.md §4.3 text and §5.8 wording no longer matched shipped behavior; RUN_ERROR (shipped, NFR-REL-01-aligned) was absent from the spec's 'consuming at minimum' AG-UI event list
confirmedFindings.fix: tasks.md §4.3 reworded (callback turns DO publish TEXT_MESSAGE_*; the distinction is no ModelPort.send()); §5.8 clarified (dashboard route tests run under test:run); RUN_ERROR added to spec.md's minimum-event list; openspec validate --all --strict still 6/6.

deferredWithOwner.title: BOOKING_PENDING for a request created AFTER the dashboard connected is dropped by the knownRequestIds gate (the per-turn STATE events are keyed by threadId=chatId and never register the numeric request id in the dashboard aggregate)
deferredWithOwner.why-deferred: There is no live path to a pending booking in S3 (propose_slots/request_hold are pass-through no-ops until S4), so this cannot manifest in the S3 demo. S4 wires the hold->pending flow and must make the new request known to the dashboard aggregate — e.g. republish a dashboard-scoped STATE_SNAPSHOT (or a lightweight REQUEST_CREATED event) when a request row is created, or have the reducer treat BOOKING_PENDING's self-sufficient payload as registering the entry. The S3 reducer is spec-compliant for the 'unknown id ignored' scenario as-is.

deferredWithOwner.title: Delete-lead is not idempotent across >1 pending booking: if one calendar event delete succeeds and a later one fails, the route bails before the DB delete, and a retry re-attempts the already-deleted event (GoogleCalendarPort.deleteEvent does not treat 404/410 as success), so the lead can never be deleted
deferredWithOwner.why-deferred: A lead with >1 pending booking only arises once S4 enables re-proposing a slot. Fix belongs with S4's calendar-cleanup: make deleteEvent idempotent (treat 404/410 as success) and/or delete events best-effort collecting failures. S3's single-pending delete path is fully tested and correct.

deferredWithOwner.title: HallMap does not update a seat's color/clickability in real time from a live BOOKING_PENDING — dashboard.hallMap is replaced only by a full dashboard-scoped STATE_SNAPSHOT, so a live pending seat stays gray until a snapshot arrives
deferredWithOwner.why-deferred: The only live event that moves a request to pending is produced by S4's hold flow (absent in S3). S4 must refresh dashboard.hallMap when a booking status changes (republish a dashboard-scoped STATE_SNAPSHOT after the status event) or the reducer must derive seat status from livePendingQueue too. Static HallMap rendering + precedence + click behavior is fully tested in S3.

deferredWithOwner.title: dashboard-state.dateAndHourOf slices slot_start assuming a Europe/Kyiv wall-clock offset; a UTC/Z-formatted slot_start (as packages/db/src/bookings.test.ts's own precedent stores) would mis-bucket HallMap seats by the Kyiv offset with no error
deferredWithOwner.why-deferred: No live code writes bookings.slot_start until S4's hold-creation. Contract S4 must honor: write slot_start as a Europe/Kyiv-offset ISO string (matching S3's HallMap fixtures), OR dashboard-state must normalize any offset/Z to Kyiv before bucketing. Recorded as a data-integrity contract for S4.

informationalNoAction: Localhost binding verified correct (dev/start -H 127.0.0.1; HttpAguiPublisher posts only to a developer-set localhost AGUI_INGEST_URL). Negative 'unreachable from LAN' assertion is a Stage E E2E task (tasks.md §1.5), not yet run.

SQL fully parameterized (better-sqlite3 prepared statements); React auto-escapes all lead-supplied text (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML anywhere); no secrets logged by the new routes/publisher; no NEXT_PUBLIC_* in the dashboard.

SSE stream lifecycle verified sound: controller.error() (not close()) avoids the unread-queue reader.closed hang; cancel() + abort listener unsubscribe idempotently; enqueue wrapped in try/catch; the snapshot better-sqlite3 connection is closed in finally.
agui-hub module-singleton pub/sub is safe under Node's single-threaded model; no unbounded-subscriber cap (acceptable for single-teacher localhost; noted).
npm audit: 0 high/critical; 2 moderate (PostCSS build-time CSS stringifier via next's toolchain, not reachable by runtime input) — routine next bump when convenient.

Pending queue renders the full RequestCard rather than a distinct compact 'entry then open' two-tier view — satisfies the letter of the oversized-content scenario (bounded, no h-scroll, full text reachable); accepted UX simplification for a single-teacher tool.
